label: prf:phi-q-tower-algebraic-stratification
title: Proof of phi q tower algebraic stratification
html:
Proof. Proof of phi q tower algebraic stratification

Proof

  1. Algebraic stratification exists. For each S, \beta_S is a well-defined element of the braid group B_n (skein-smoothing commutes with the braid-group structure). The image \rho(\beta_S) in H_n(R, q) is an explicit Laurent polynomial in the Hecke generators. Direct from the definition of skein smoothing.

  2. The mass formula sums over levels. Per the mass endomorphism tower formula, the categorical mass equals \bigl\lvert\prod_i \hat V_i\bigr\rvert + \sum_i \Phi_q(|\hat V_i|) + z^2 \sum_{(i,j)} \Phi_q(|\hat V_i \hat V_j|). The first term corresponds to \beta_\emptyset (level 0); the singleton sum to \beta_{\{i\}} (level 1); the pair sum to \beta_{\{i,j\}} (level 2). Identification term-by-term. Direct.

  3. No level \geq 3 contribution at fixed jet level n. Per pentagon ascension (jet-tower remark §"Pentagon ascension"), any would-be order-3 contribution \Phi_q(|\hat V_i \hat V_j \hat V_k|) rewrites via the pentagon identity as a product of order-\leq 2 factors at level n plus a residual that ascends to level (n+1) as a new singleton or pair. Iteration covers all higher orders.

  4. Each summand is in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}]. \hat V_S is a Laurent polynomial in q^{1/2} with integer coefficients (algebraic quantum volume); the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q is given as a formal product \prod_{n \geq 0} (1 - q^n \cdot x) in \mathbb{Z}[q]\![[x]\!] and reduces to a polynomial when truncated at the GB-filtration level appropriate for the partition data. No convergence condition on |q| is required for the algebraic-side statement.

\square

Relation to the JSJ archimedean bridge

The conjecture Φ_q-tower JSJ archimedean bridge states that under \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} each algebraic stratum S maps to a JSJ piece of \widehat\beta, with the algebraic value \Phi_q(|\hat V_S|) τ-realising to \rho_q \cdot \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(S^3 \setminus K_S). That conjecture interprets the algebraic stratification on the 3-manifold side; the algebraic stratification itself is unconditional.

In terms of the strict Archimedean wall:

  • The statement of the mass formula uses the algebraic stratification (this proposition); 3-manifold language does not appear.
  • The interpretation as a JSJ-piecewise sum is a τ-image conjecture, on the right side of τ.
  • No proof anywhere in the algebraic engine invokes JSJ / hyperbolic-volume / Mostow / Thurston as a derivation input.
